name: Couple Goals AI
tagline: Generate beautiful couple photos with AI
description: Generate beautiful couple photos with AI. Upload two photos, choose a romantic template, and create memories together. Couple Goals AI is a tool designed to generate romantic couple photos using AI. By uploading two individual photos, users can choose from a curated collection of romantic templates to create a meaningful and unique couple photo. Users can customise their created photos by uploading clear everyday smartphone pictures, picking a desired template, and letting the AI handle the rest
